wiki.extract: The Guaita, also known as the Rocca is one of three towered peaks overlooking the city of San Marino, the capital of San Marino. The other two are Cesta and Montale.

The City of San Marino, also known simply as San Marino and locally as Città, is the capital city of the Republic of San Marino and one of its nine castelli. It has a population of 4,118. It is on the western slopes of San Marino's highest point, Monte Titano. It is also the fifth-least-populated national capital in the world.

The Palazzo Pubblico is the city hall of the City of San Marino. It is where official state ceremonies take place, and it is the seat of the Republic's main institutional and administrative bodies: the Captains Regent, the Grand and General Council, the Council of XII, and the Congress of State.

head_of_state: Captains Regent (dual heads of state, elected every six months)

wiki.extract: Medieval Times Dinner and Tournament is an American dinner theater featuring staged medieval-style games, sword-fighting, and jousting. Medieval Times Entertainment, the holding company, is headquartered in Irving, Texas.

Marinus is a Christian saint, who according to hagiographical accounts recorded centuries after his lifetime was the founder of a chapel and monastery in 301 from whose initial community the state of San Marino later grew.

food_writeup: San Marino's cuisine is heavily influenced by Italian traditions, featuring dishes like tortellini, piadina, and local cheeses, often accompanied by regional wines.
brief_history: Founded in 301 AD by Saint Marinus, San Marino claims to be the world's oldest republic. It has maintained independence through diplomatic skill and neutrality, surviving various European conflicts.
